task.title: Record independently observed task Verification
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/767 with a caller-owned verifier boundary that records evidence for one exact task Attempt without assistant or lifecycle authority.
acceptance_criteria: Supply the exact active task and parent Attempt to one caller-owned verifier invocation.
Persist successful non-blank output as linked Verification evidence while leaving the task active.
Reject invalid lineage, duplicate identity, checker failure, blank output, and racing writes without retrying the verifier.
Do not invoke the assistant provider, mutate transcripts, or transition task or workflow lifecycle.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused task verification runtime test failed because the verifier trait, request, result, and runtime operation did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added exact-input, lineage, no-session, checker-error, blank-output, and deterministic race tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Existing task observation lineage and optimistic append checks could establish provenance without routing checker output through the assistant provider.
attempts.patch: Added the caller-owned TaskVerifier boundary, immutable exact-Attempt request, preflight validation, linked append, typed execution errors, ADR, and runtime/task documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Read-only review identified that unassociated-task behavior and verifier error-source chaining deserved explicit assertions.
attempts.patch: Added both focused assertions before the single reviewed commit and reran the full quality gate.

outcome.summary: Callers can run one independent checker against an exact active-task Attempt and durably preserve its non-blank evidence without granting the checker provider, transcript, or terminal authority.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test task_verification_runtime

lessons: Independent Verification must use a boundary distinct from assistant generation so model claims cannot become their own proof.
Validate exact lineage and fresh identity before checker effects, then preserve authoritative append races without retries.
Execution failure and observed evidence need separate typed outcomes even before pass/fail evidence semantics exist.
Assert that unassociated tasks remain verifiable without creating sessions and preserve verifier failures as chained error sources so boundary and diagnostic guarantees remain regression-tested.
